summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a male with a history of mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma with CNS involvement, was admitted for cycle 25 of high-dose methotrexate chemotherapy. He tolerated the infusion well but experienced delayed clearance of methotrexate, requiring extended hospitalization and increased IV fluids to 200 cc/hr. Leucovorin rescue was continued every six hours, and he was discharged with a three-day course of oral leucovorin. A severe headache prompted a head CT, which showed no acute abnormalities; the headache resolved with acetaminophen. Hypokalemia developed and was managed with supplementation. Rituximab was postponed due to allergy concerns and will be scheduled for the following weekend. He was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to restart omeprazole and aspirin, continue GenTeal eye drops, and follow up with his oncologist and ophthalmologist.
problems: Primary central nervous system lymphoma, unspecified site, extranodal and solid organ sites
